<observations>
Date: Mar 2, 2026 - Mar 15, 2026 (Consolidated Core Features & Architecture)
* 🔴 User stated they are building Ledgerly, a TypeScript invoicing SaaS for Canadian freelancers.
* 🔴 User preferences & architecture: Database schema `ledgerly_core`, production Postgres in Frankfurt region, teammate Priyanka Vashisht reviews migrations, aims for >=85% test coverage, prefers VSCode extensions for linting, and mandates `pnpm` over `npm` for all install commands.
* ✅ Core backend & services built: JWT authentication, Winston/Loggly audit logging, Handlebars/Nodemailer email notifications, Sentry error tracking, and GitHub Actions CI/CD with standard-version releases.
* ✅ PDF invoice generation completed: Built with PDFKit and QR codes, exposed via `GET /invoices/:id/pdf` with Prometheus metrics, rate limiting, and containerized deployment in staging (`v1.3.0-staging`).

Date: Mar 19, 2026
* 🔴 (07:15) User announced they will begin end-to-end testing of the invoice flow tomorrow (Mar 20).
* 🟡 (08:00) Cypress@13.2.0 installed for E2E testing with initial smoke tests passing.
* ✅ (14:00) Health-check endpoint `GET /health` added with uptime and version fields, verified with integration tests.
* 🟡 (15:30) Rate limiting (`express-rate-limit`) applied to the PDF download endpoint and documented in README (`RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS`, `MAX_REQUESTS`).
* 🟢 (17:00) Reminder scheduled for user to review Cypress test results after nightly run.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Preparing for E2E testing of the invoice flow starting tomorrow (Mar 20).
- Secondary: Reviewing Cypress test results after nightly run.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
"The application is fully containerized and set up with Cypress for E2E testing. Let me know when you're ready to review the nightly test results or if you need any adjustments before tomorrow's E2E testing begins."
</suggested-response>
